alerts.detail: The put-in marked on the map is wrong. There are flood control works in North Adams that would be suicidal to run. AFAIK, the best put-in is off Ashland avenue.

detail.description:
An easy run with little gradient.

There are 2 dams at Route 2 that will need to be portaged and another near the Stop and Shop using the put in East of North Adams. To avoid portaging put in at Ashton Avenue downstream (east) of North Adams
